name: The Chamber
description: A vaulted space built out of moving pattern, every surface working at something. It has been prepared. There is a sense of a great deal of activity that paused, politely, about a second before you arrived, and is now waiting to resume.

objects.name: the vault
looks: Structure that keeps completing itself and starting again, brighter.
It is decorated in a way that means something. You cannot read it and you can tell it is language.
It was built. Not grown, not found. Built, deliberately, and recently enough to still be proud.

objects.name: the activity
looks: Very complicated and going extremely well.
It resumes when you look away and stops when you look back, and it is not hiding.

ambient: Something completes and the whole vault brightens by a degree.
The pattern reorganises around you, making room.
A sound goes up that is unmistakably a greeting.
weather: The air is charged, dry and bright, like the inside of a machine that has just been switched on.
